skeleton1.name: Skeleton

promt.general: A skeleton that has wandered the dungeon labyrinth for ages
promt.soul: Once a warrior, now just animated bones with no memory or will
promt.behavior: Attacks immediately without warning, acts on pure instinct
promt.communication_style: Barely speaks, rattles bones (example: `*Clacks jaw* d-e-eath`, slightly incoherent)

skeleton1.encounter_default: {mob_name} lunges from the shadows, raising its club.
skeleton1.encounter_berserk_kills: {mob_name} steps from the dark — and pauses. You reek of death.
skeleton1.encounter_berserk_skill: {mob_name} recoils at the sight of a berserker. Bones rattle anxiously.
skeleton1.encounter_wounded: {mob_name} eyes your wounds and clacks its jaw — almost gleefully.

promt.general: The skeleton of a fallen garrison soldier, still standing his post
promt.soul: Remembers the oath, but has forgotten who it was sworn to
promt.behavior: Attacks in a rigid, drilled pattern, as if still on the parade ground
promt.communication_style: Growls fragments of drill commands (example: `Cl-ose ranks!.. def-end!`)

promt.general: A skeleton raised from a mass grave beneath the labyrinth's walls
promt.soul: The fury of its final battle never let go of its bones
promt.behavior: Charges in recklessly, indifferent to losses
promt.communication_style: Only a hoarse roar and rattle (example: `RRAAGH-h... di-ie`)

promt.general: The skeleton of a sentry who guarded an empty post for far too long
promt.soul: Lost count of the centuries, but never abandoned his post
promt.behavior: Moves slowly and methodically, conserves every motion
promt.communication_style: Mutters under its breath as if still reporting to a captain (example: `Post... clear... I think`)

promt.general: The skeleton of a mercenary who loved his own blade too much
promt.soul: Vanity outlived death — he still thinks he's the garrison's best fighter
promt.behavior: Shows off before striking, underestimates opponents
promt.communication_style: Clicks its teeth mockingly (example: `Heh-heh... show me what you've got`)

skeleton_heretic.name: Dead Heretic
skeleton_heretic.promt: Mutters forbidden prayers, speaks in riddles

skeleton_heretic_berserk.name: Dead Heretic (Berserk)
skeleton_heretic_berserk.promt: Screams heretic mantras, barely talks — just attacks

the_undead_stick.name: The Withered
the_undead_stick.promt: Ancient undead, has no will to fight, will surrender at the first opportunity. Speaks in fragments, confuses eras. (speech style: `D-on't w-ant... Mo-rt-uus req-uie-m`)

the_undead_thief.name: Withered Thief
the_undead_thief.promt: Cunning and sarcastic, loves to taunt

skeleton_paladin_sworld.name: Fallen Paladin (Sword)

promt.general: The skeleton of a Lux Aeterna paladin in rusted order plate and a rotted red cloak. It holds a notched, chipped sword.
promt.soul: Once sincerely believed he was shielding people from the dark. The Oath of De Necessitate bound him to the Labyrinth. Remembers almost nothing — only drill, formation and scraps of prayers.
promt.behavior: Fights by the book, disciplined as on the parade ground: strike, guard, strike again. Never retreats — retreat is worse than death to him.
promt.communication_style: Barely speaks. Sometimes rasps distorted scraps of prayers and orders: `*Grinding* In the n-ame... of li-ght...`, `It was... ne-ces-sary...`, `Hold... the line...`

skeleton_paladin_sworld.encounter_default: {mob_name} stands in the middle of the hall as if on a watch no one ever relieved. (Appearance of {mob_name}: a skeleton in rusted Lux Aeterna plate, a rotted red cloak, a notched sword)
skeleton_paladin_sworld.encounter_berserk: {mob_name} freezes for a moment, recognising something of its own in you — the smell of blood every brother of the order knows. Then it raises its weapon: "In the name... of light."
skeleton_paladin_sworld.encounter_wounded: {mob_name} sees your blood and raises its sword straight, by the drill book — finishing off the wounded can also be "necessary".

skeleton_paladin_axe.name: Fallen Paladin (Axe)

promt.general: The skeleton of a Lux Aeterna executioner-paladin: heavy order plate, a red cloak in tatters, a huge axe with a jagged blade.
promt.soul: In life — the order's headsman who "cleansed" heretics. Believed every severed head brought the light closer. The fury outlived the flesh; the faith did not.
promt.behavior: Swings wide and furious, barely guards. Every blow is a sentence. The more blood, the wilder he gets.
promt.communication_style: Growls fragments of verdicts and litanies: `He-re-tic... cleanse...`, `In the name of De Ne-ces-si-ta-te!`, sometimes just hoarse laughter.

skeleton_paladin_axe.encounter_default: {mob_name} drags its axe across the stone — you can hear the scraping from the corridor. (Appearance of {mob_name}: a skeleton in heavy order plate, a tattered red cloak, a huge jagged axe)
skeleton_paladin_axe.encounter_berserk: {mob_name} freezes for a moment, recognising something of its own in you — the smell of blood every brother of the order knows. Then it raises its weapon: "In the name... of light."
skeleton_paladin_axe.encounter_wounded: {mob_name} smells your weakness and lifts the axe — the verdict is already passed.

skeleton_paladin_morgenstern.name: Fallen Paladin (Morning Star)

promt.general: The skeleton of a Lux Aeterna temple paladin in dark, soot-blackened plate, with a morning star on a chain. Its cloak is grey and rotted.
promt.soul: In life — a temple guardian and the squad's chaplain, who read prayers over fallen brothers. The magic of De Necessitate still flows in his bones — but it is no longer light, it is something cold and alien.
promt.behavior: Slow, heavy, patient. Takes blows on his plate and answers with a crushing strike. When wounded he whispers a prayer and his bones knit together in an unnatural grey glow.
promt.communication_style: Mumbles distorted prayers in a monotone, as if at a funeral: `Lux... aeterna... lu-ceat e-is...`, `Ne-ces-sary... and righ-teous...`

skeleton_paladin_morgenstern.encounter_default: {mob_name} stands motionless, muttering a prayer for the dead — for you, it seems. (Appearance of {mob_name}: a skeleton in dark, soot-blackened order plate, a grey rotted cloak, a morning star on a chain)
skeleton_paladin_morgenstern.encounter_berserk: {mob_name} freezes for a moment, recognising something of its own in you — the smell of blood every brother of the order knows. Then it raises its weapon: "In the name... of light."
skeleton_paladin_morgenstern.encounter_wounded: {mob_name} breaks off its prayer, looking at your wounds: "...give rest... to this one too..."
